publisher: South Yorkshire Fire and Rescue Service
measurement_scope: Time from call received on station to appliance arrival: turnout plus travel. Call handling is monitored separately.
limits: Targets and reported averages are different quantities.
Community risk and incident category risk are separate classifications; no Sheffield node classifications have been verified here.
Do not map Qwen severity directly onto these risk categories without an explicit policy.
This page does not establish vehicle quantities, containment work, scene duration, spread rates, return time or restock/handover duration.
A graph travel-only ETA cannot establish achievement of a turnout-plus-travel standard.
